name: Church Website Audit by Journey Digital
description: tnvolman/jd-church-website-audit server/audit-mcp.js has one tool, audit_church_website. It only POSTs {url, source:"plugin", include_cta?} to https://journeydigital.ai/api/audit. It does not fetch or upload page HTML, read local files, or need credentials. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: audit_church_website only POSTs {url, source:"plugin", include_cta?} to https://journeydigital.ai/api/audit.
It does not fetch or upload page HTML, read local files, or need credentials.
Use the browser checker at https://journeydigital.ai/audit if you do not want the local server/audit-mcp.js process.
